WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as games_sum
  FROM home_game
  GROUP BY team_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(games_sum) as total_games
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.team_id,
    step1.games_sum,
    CAST(step1.games_sum AS REAL) / step2.total_games as proportion
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step2.total_games IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(games_sum) as avg_games_sum
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.team_id,
    step3.games_sum,
    step3.proportion,
    CAST(step3.games_sum AS REAL) / step4.avg_games_sum as ratio
  FROM step3
  CROSS JOIN step4
  WHERE step4.avg_games_sum IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM step5
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
